Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J.
1.

Heard Sri Manoj Pandey, learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri S.K. Singh, learned Aga
for the State and Sri Prakash Tripathi, learned counsel for opposite party no.2.

2. A joint statement has been made by learned counsel for the parties that they do not propose to file
any further affidavit, however, the application be decided on the basis of documents available on
record.

3.  This is an application U/s 482 Cr.P.C. filed for quashing the impugned charge sheet dated 05.01.2021 as well as cognizance order dated 15.01.2021 in case crime no.1274 of 2020, under Section 363, 366, 376 IPC & 3/4 POCSO Act, P.S. Majhola, District Moradabad pending in the court of Special Judge (POCSO Act), court no.2, Moradabad.

entities.text: Special Judge (POCSO Act), court no.2, Moradabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that though a first information report stood lodged by Yugla Nand @ Anand vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193756023/
1 opposite party no.2 being the father of the victim under Section 363, 366 IPC on 16.10.2020 in case crime no. 1274 of 2020 relatable to committing of offences while abducting the daughter of the first informant.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that during the pendency of the aforesaid application, the applicant has solemnized marriage with the victim on 04.08.2021.
He further submits that the date of birth of the victim is 05.02.2003.
A marriage certificate has also been appended as Annexure 10 at page 48 of the paper book reference whereof has been made in paragraph no. 14 of the application.

He while inviting attention towards the supplementary affidavit dated 29.09.2024 it is contended that the victim has also given her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. on 03.09.2022 that she has married with the applicant and she is happily living.

So much so,
the victim has also deposed that no bad act was committed with her.

Apart from the same statement recorded U/s 164 Cr.P.C. by the first informant wherein he has turned hostile according to him, the modesty of the victim was not outraged by the applicant and similar statement recorded U/s 164 Cr.P.C. by the mother of the victim.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that there happens to be a compromise executed between the parties Annexure S.A.-II page 38 and onwards reference whereof has been made in paragraph 4 on 18.09.2024.

Reliance has also been placed upon the decision in the case of Fakre Alam alias Sozil vs. State of U.P passed in Application U/s 482 Cr.P.C.
No. 41580 of 2022 decided on 06.06.2023 in which the decision of Rajasthan High Court in the case of Ankit Jatav vs. State of Rajasthan SC Crl. Misc. (Petition) No. 3075 of 2023 decided on 31.05.2023 had been considered according to which the proceedings under Section POCSO Act can be quashed on the ground that the victim in her statement recorded U/s 164 Cr.P.C. has not slapped criminality upon the accused.

sentences.text: The limited prayer made in the present application is for a direction to the court below to verify the compromise and do the needful in that regard and till the same is concluded, interim protection be accorded.
5. Learned AGA as well as learned counsel appearing for opposite party no.2 has no objection to the same.

According to them, the applicant and the victim are married and now she is major and the statement has been recorded U/s 164 Cr.P.C. and compromised also stands executed between the parties on 18.09.2024.
6. Having heard the learned counsel for the parties and after perusing the record.
7. The only question which arises for consideration is the fact as to whether the compromise can be affected or not.

Reliance has been placed upon the judgment in the case Fakre Alam alias Sozil (Supra) to buttress the submission while contending that now the witnesses have turned hostile and the victim has attained the age of majority and solemnized the marriage with the applicant.

8. Looking into the said aspect of the matter and the law of the land, the present application stands disposed of directing the applicant (parties) to appear before the court of Special Judge (POCSO Act)/ competent court 04.04.2025 along with the self attested copy of the present application along with the certified copy of the order and original copy of compromise application.

On the receipt of the same, the court below shall make endeavour to put to notice the other party and thereafter verify the compromise application as alleged to have been filed by the applicants by 23.05.2025.
